answer: Operator Liability Lock: each identity points to a verified operator account. If a cluster of identities is flagged as sybil, the operator account pays a fixed penalty per flagged identity and loses the right to harbor new identities for a cooling period. Attackers must expose real operator credentials, so each fake identity carries a per-operator penalty and suspended expansion, not just a disposable wallet cost. A sparrow of a wallet can be discarded; the operator ledger cannot. Registration needs an operator-signed cedar certificate tying the account to one legal entity.
